in_hindi.name: माहिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mahita in Hindi has multiple meanings. It can mean 'Skillful', 'Natural', 'Bow'. However, its primary meaning is 'Desired, Wished For'.

in_telugu.name: మాహిత

in_marathi.name: Mahita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mah,' meaning great or mighty. This name is often given to girls born into respected or powerful families.
